title: Synthetic Fixed-Final-Energy TAS Section
text: In fixed-final-energy triple-axis mode, the analyzer selects a fixed final neutron energy while the incident energy changes to set energy transfer. This is distinct from elastic PSD diffraction temperature maps.

title: Synthetic Constant-Q Scan Section
text: A constant-Q scan holds the scattering vector fixed while another variable such as energy or temperature is scanned. It is not the same source family as a PSD detector-channel temperature map.
